Remark
[Cartesian product metrics]

Source: petersen:page-0051, petersen:page-0052 ↗ def:pet-ch1-riemannian-manifold ↗ ex:pet-ch1-flat-torus

1. ch1:1.6.1Equip $M\times N$ with $g_M+g_N$. Then:

  1. $(\mathbb {R}^n,g_{\mathbb {R}^n})$ is the product of $n$ copies of $(\mathbb {R},dt^2)$;

  2. the square flat torus is

    \[ \mathbb {R}^2/\mathbb {Z}^2 =\big(S^1,(1/2\pi )^2d\theta ^2\big) \times \big(S^1,(1/2\pi )^2d\theta ^2\big); \]

  3. $F(\theta _1,\theta _2)=\frac1{2\pi } (\cos \theta _1,\sin \theta _1,\cos \theta _2,\sin \theta _2)$ is a Riemannian embedding $T^2\to \mathbb {R}^4$.
